articles.summary: Acquisition accelerates Fuel50's capabilities and its reach with enterprise employers, as workforce intelligence becomes central to the AI-enabled workplace Phoenix Education Partners, Inc. (“Phoenix Education” or the “Company”) (NYSE: PXED) today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Fuel50, Inc., an AI-powered workforce transformation platform. This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/2026091762186
articles.title: Phoenix Education Partners to Acquire Fuel50, Advancing the Future of Workforce Transformation
